answer: In an oasis settlement where basalt walls impede radio, officials mail challenge codes inside a sonnet booklet. A registrar verifies returned codes and signs credentials bound to canonical postal delivery points and the poll. Validators reject invalid signatures and repeated delivery points, including reissues. Extra votes require access to more delivery points or interception of their mail; sequential reuse adds nothing within the poll. This trusts address deduplication and mail security, and counts delivery points, not people.
